title: AI-Powered High-Precision Weather Forecasting Model
summary: Alibaba reports lower weather-forecast error than ECMWF-IFS, including a 57.8% regional improvement, and names State Grid Shandong as a test setting.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Baguan submission reports improvements over ECMWF-IFS on selected forecast variables, including regional and global model comparisons. State Grid Shandong is named among test settings. Better renewable-power forecasting and grid operations are intended applications, while the source does not quantify resulting dispatch, reliability, or emissions changes.
purpose: Improve weather forecasts for power, agriculture, and other weather-sensitive uses.
deployer: State Grid Shandong Electric Power Co., Ltd. (test setting)

ratings.reason: The reported regional forecast-error improvement over ECMWF-IFS is 57.8%, with additional global comparisons; this is improved forecasting capability, not a measured grid outcome.
Renewable-energy uptake and climate benefits are anticipated downstream effects.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Powered High-Precision Weather Forecasting Model

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Baguan reports improved regional and global weather forecasts

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
